headline: [Exclusive] Seoul apartment gifts exceed last year's total… rising sharply both inside and outside the city
summary: Gifts of multi-unit residential buildings in Seoul exceeded last year's total within seven months. Increases were seen in Gangnam, mid-tier districts and cheaper outskirts.
why: Property gifts between family members are used to transfer housing assets, and their volume often reflects tax planning ahead of rules changes and the state of the housing market.
